summary: We developed a very fun and interesting game where you play as a black hole and try to catch falling stars. This game also has a very fun twist; you can unlock a mini-wiki on the 12 zodiac constellations. We believe this game is important to make people understand how interesting constellations are.
details: Our project increases awareness about constellations and our intend is to make people learn about constellations without it having to feel like tedious school-work and instead like a fun game that also tests your reflexes. We used the coding language Python and a module in it, known as Tkinter to build our project in record-breaking time. We thought of this project idea completely on our own, on a random Tuesday in school and then we started developing it own Google Meet calls because we couldn't meet often, but overall this was a pretty fun challenge that tested our coding skills and brought us on a higher level in programing.
